postxconfig-NT-GFS.txt (Submodule_Fixture stand-in)

Minimal, byte-stable stand-in for the UPP post control file owned by the
sorc/upp.fd submodule. It exists only so a fixture-backed verification deploy
can copy a submodule source without a fatal missing-source error.

Free of all templating tokens so the Token_Scan over a rendered EXPDIR passes.
See the directory README for details.
